title: Design Beneath The Surface – Discover Our Undercounter Range
bodyHtml:
The Enjoy Two - 540 x 345 x 175 mm

Design, Evolved Below the Surface

Our Undercounter Basin range expands with a renewed commitment to subtle design and intelligent performance.

This deeper, more versatile collection offers refined solutions for modern bathrooms — bringing together architectural clarity, technical precision, and aesthetic restraint.


Happy Hour Oval 57 - 570 x 380 x 150 mm

Engineered for Every Environment

The new lineup introduces integrated overflows, reversible positioning, and innovative hidden Siphonic Overflow technology — delivering seamless drainage performance without visual compromise.

A series of slimmer, reduced-depth options enhances spatial efficiency, offering comfort and usability within even the most compact layouts.


Cubic 80 Undercounter Basin - 840 x 455 x 155 mm

Italian Design with a New Depth

New to the collection, the Happy Hour Undercounter series channels the artistry of Hatria Ceramica.

Made in Italy and offered in a palette of premium finishes, these expressive forms complement a diverse range of vanity configurations and interior directions — from restrained minimalism to layered material compositions.


Happy Hour 75 - 750 x 390 x 145 mm

Reimagining a Studio Classic

The next evolution of our Fall series refines its sculptural geometry while introducing full overflow capability.

With compliance now built into its elegant form, Fall V2 delivers design continuity across residential and commercial environments — a meeting point between soft contours and technical sophistication.


Fall 60 V2 - 600 x 370 x 180 mm
